text: Thank you for staying close to the team during the audit. Keeping our three largest clients this year was your biggest result. You exceeded expectations on the KPIs that matter most. Delegating the weekly reports is the one thing I want you to change. It is worth investing in a negotiation course for you. Mentoring the two new managers will be your main goal next year.

When we buy a company, I read the performance reviews before I read the contracts. A review that says great attitude, team player tells me nothing. A review that says managing the bank account through two audits was her biggest result tells me exactly who to keep. I am looking for activities, not adjectives. If a founder cannot describe what his best people actually do, I assume he has not been watching.

For years I avoided giving candid feedback. Telling someone they are underperforming is hard to do, so I kept postponing it. What I learned is that waiting is worse. Waiting six months turned a small problem into a resignation. Now I do it in the first week, and I always start with one specific thing they did well. It is worth saying the good part first, but only if it is true.
